title: Waring rank of certain complete intersection forms
summary: The complete intersection forms are the homogeneous polynomials whose annihilator ideal or the Macaulay dual, is an Artinian complete intersection ideal. In this paper, we compute the Waring rank of certain complete intersection forms. As an application, we compute the Waring rank of binomials whose annihilator is a complete intersection ideal. Further, we also compute the Waring rank of the product of binary forms in different sets of variables.
